assessment_summary: Reviewed the installation guide and summary, then independently inspected the resulting environment. Installation method confirmed as the documented Docker Compose (shared infra) + Process Compose (app services, workers, seeds, frontend) local flow at /workspace commit 0cd030a; the only untracked change is the documented docker-compose.override.yaml workaround for unpullable upstream MinIO images, which is a legitimate adaptation, not a missing artifact. Prerequisite tool versions match the guide. Shared infrastructure is fully up (11 containers; PostgreSQL/Keycloak/MinIO/Temporal healthy), with expected MinIO buckets and a registered Temporal namespace/task queue, and SpiceDB serving. Process Compose reports 38 processes: 33 Running, 5 seed jobs Completed with exit 0 and zero failures; every readiness-probed service is Ready and all 16 backend /healthz endpoints return HTTP 200. Functional behavior was demonstrated rather than mere file presence: a complete simulated browser OIDC login (frontend 302 -> Keycloak -> /oauth2/callback -> SPARK Workflow app HTML) succeeded, authenticated API calls through oauth2-proxy returned seeded data (project statuses/types, FCS template categories/document-types), and the guide's core workflow step — creating a Verfahren — completed with HTTP 201 and was then listed. Seed content was corroborated directly in Postgres (project_logic, formal_completeness_check, administrative_file_draft, gesetze-normen with 2187 norms, jura-db, begruendungen-db). Limitations: the external LLM and Docling endpoints are deliberately absent (the guide explicitly states the local stack does not start an LLM provider and the local Docling container is optional/pointed-at), so a live KI-Analyse workflow execution could not be validated end-to-end — this does not indicate installation failure. The examination service shows 21 restarts but is currently Running/Ready/exit 0, consistent with the documented one-time migration readiness retries and not evidence of ongoing failure. All decisive checks passed, so the installation is assessed as successful.
